description: What the user did in their own browser (clicks, field changes, Enter, form submits, page loads, new tabs) since you last looked. Attached to the user's Chrome only. Use it to work together in one tab: ask the user to do a step (log in, pick something, approve a 2FA prompt), then call this with waitSeconds to see when and what they did. Every other tool result also starts with this report when there is something new. Password and card fields never show values.

waitSeconds.description: Wait up to this long for the user to do something (returns as soon as they do). Default 0: just report.

name: playwright_user_activity
